import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        static final int MAX_NODES = 10001;
        List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];
        int[] visited = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] cur = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int node_count = 0;
        int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] potential = new int[MAX_NODES];

        MCMF() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        int create_node() {
            adj[node_count].clear();
            return node_count++;
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, cost));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new int[]{dist[source] = 0, source});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] top = pq.poll();
                int du = top[0], u = top[1];
                if (visited[u] != 0) continue;
                visited[u] = 1;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    int v = e.to;
                    int dv = du + potential[u] + e.cost - potential[v];
                    if (e.cap == 0 || visited[v] != 0 || dist[v] <= dv) continue;
                    pq.offer(new int[]{dist[v] = dv, v});
                }
            }
            return visited[sink] != 0;
        }

        boolean dinic_bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            visited[source] = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (visited[v] != 0 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[v] != dist[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) continue;
                    visited[v] = visited[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
            return visited[sink] != 0;
        }

        int dinic_dfs(int u, int sink, int flow) {
            if (u == sink) return flow;
            int pushed = 0;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
                cur[u] = i;
                Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
                int v = e.to;
                if (e.cap == 0 || visited[v] != visited[u] + 1) continue;
                if (dist[v] != dist[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) continue;
                int df = dinic_dfs(v, sink, Math.min(e.cap, flow));
                pushed += df;
                flow -= df;
                e.cap -= df;
                adj[v].get(e.rev).cap += df;
                if (flow == 0) break;
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        int[] min_cost_max_flow(int source, int sink, int max_flow_limit) {
            int total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
            while (dijkstra(source, sink)) {
                int flow = 0;
                while (dinic_bfs(source, sink)) {
                    Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                    int df = dinic_dfs(source, sink, max_flow_limit);
                    max_flow_limit -= df;
                    flow += df;
                    if (max_flow_limit == 0) break;
                }
                total_flow += flow;
                total_cost += (dist[sink] + potential[sink]) * flow;
                for (int i = 0; i < node_count; i++)
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                if (max_flow_limit == 0) break;
            }
            return new int[]{total_flow, total_cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int layers = Math.max(n, k) * 2;
        MCMF mcmf = new MCMF();
        mcmf.create_node();
        int s = mcmf.create_node();
        int t = mcmf.create_node();
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            --a;
            mcmf.add_edge(s, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            --u; --v;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n, v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n, v2 = v + i * n;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    mcmf.add_edge(u1, v1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    mcmf.add_edge(v2, u2, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n, v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                mcmf.add_edge(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < layers; ++i)
            mcmf.add_edge(i * n, t, INF, 0);
        System.out.println(mcmf.min_cost_max_flow(s, t, INF)[1]);
    }
}
